question: Within 80 kilometers, where can I find a café toward Fairfield Inn & Suites Baltimore Downtown/Inner Harbor, Baltimore, MD from 3 Palms Zoo & Education Center, Townsend, DE?
sql: WITH start_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%3 Palms Zoo & Education Center%' LIMIT 1 ), end_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Fairfield Inn & Suites Baltimore Downtown/Inner Harbor%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, start_location AS sl, end_location AS el WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography, 80000) AND ABS(MOD(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geometry, p.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geometry, el.geometry)) + 360 + 180, 360) - 180) <= 45;
